The background texture anomaly (severity 2.0) is also valid; the blue pattern is repetitive and lacks depth, suggesting a generated or poorly textured backdrop. The Perceptual Quality Auditor missed these structural issues because it only looks for noise/blur, highlighting the importance of the Router's visual inspection here.
